errors.evidence: The Y-axis range shown on the chart starts at 15000, not 17000.
The labels on the Y-axis (17000, 19000, 21000, etc.) are spaced at intervals of 2000, not 1000.

errors.text_span: На графиката е представена една линия в син цвят с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two separate data series: a solid blue line without markers, and a series of blue circular markers (a scatter plot). The description incorrectly combines them into a single entity.
The solid blue line ends at approximately 27,500 in 2022, making 28,000 a significant overestimation.
The description fails to mention the distinct flat section of the solid line between 2019 and 2020, where the value remains constant at approximately 20,000.

errors.text_span: като стойността нараства от около 18500 до около 21500
errors.evidence: In the period until 2020, the solid line reaches a value of approximately 20,000, not 21,500.
By 2021, the value of the solid line increases to approximately 24,000, not 25,500.
